title: Piercing Statue Solo #127 (힙컷 · P150 정의형 · 몸통 3조각 · 왼팔 투명(루비색 유리) · 오른팔 목재(purpleheart) · 몸통 [가로 3단] 내용물(사파이어+수정 조각) / 목재(ebony) / 투명(로즈핑크 유리) · 왼허벅지 수조(내용물 물) · 오른허벅지 내용물(코발트 블루 유리+나비) · 체형 still-visible cinched waist beneath · 트윈테일 · 발레아쥬 · 메이크업 구풍 · 금속 청동 · 쥬얼리 없음)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut statue multi-material portrait: real face and neck, and a sculpted body made of different materials — her left arm clear crystal, her right arm carved wood, her torso split into three pieces (solid glass holding embedded objects, carved wood and clear crystal), her left thigh a glass vessel full of water and her right thigh solid glass holding embedded objects. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her sculpted form comes to an end at her thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Like any real person she is slightly asymmetrical: a few small natural beauty marks and freckles scattered unevenly, one side of her neck and shoulder very slightly warmer and more freckled than the other.

Piercings: An extreme, overwhelming armour of about one hundred and fifty real bronze piercings with a few red-enamel beads among them covering the face and neck: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller ring above it, three bronze rings through each nostril and a small stud at the tip of the nose; two straight bronze bars across the bridge of the nose between the brows; six thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; three rows of five small bronze studs across the forehead above the brows; six small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; two rows of six small studs along each cheekbone; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips with a small stud on each side of it; a big bronze hoop, four smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and six small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and five rings through the chin; six small studs along each jaw; a column of five small studs down each side of the neck; on each ear a full dense row of twelve oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and ten fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: A still-visible cinched waist beneath a full soft chest, wide curving hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, her left arm clear crystal, her right arm carved wood, her torso split into three pieces (solid glass holding embedded objects, carved wood and clear crystal), her left thigh a glass vessel full of water and her right thigh solid glass holding embedded objects.

Boundary (skin to material, at underarm height): A single straight, horizontal line runs across her body at underarm height, level with both armpits. Real skin above this line — her face, neck, both shoulders, and the very tops of both upper arms. Below this line, completely different materials meet at her body's natural joints (both shoulders, both hips) and at the seams inside the torso, each keeping its own distinct appearance right up to where it touches its neighbour, never blending into it. At the underarm line itself, the material immediately below rises in a small raised step above her skin, casting a crisp shadow. Shards interlock along this line only.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent material, solid deep ruby-red cast glass, with slow internal swirls and a few tiny air bubbles, deepest crimson where thickest and pale rose at every thin edge, one continuous carved mass, never hollow, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Light passes straight through it; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved from ONE solid block of deep violet purpleheart wood, a dense hardwood of rich purple with fine straight grain, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same wood, the grain running unbroken through it. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (underarm line down to where the thighs begin): The torso, from the underarm line down to where the thighs begin, is divided into 3 stacked pieces by 2 straight horizontal seams, about 37% and 69% of the way down it. Torso piece 1 (the topmost piece, above the first seam): carved from ONE solid block of deep blue sapphire crystal, with fine silky needle inclusions forming a soft star-like shimmer, near-midnight navy where thickest and pale cornflower at every thin edge, never hollow, never split; suspended deep within it, visible through it like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are dozens of small, jagged clear quartz shards like frozen lightning bolts, each one a brighter, sharper facet than the glass around it, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity and no liquid around it. Light passes through the solid material; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it. Torso piece 2 (the middle piece, between the two seams): carved from ONE solid block of deep black ebony wood, densely fine-grained, polished to a hard, glass-like satin sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, the grain running unbroken through it. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface. Torso piece 3 (the lowest piece, below the second seam, reaching the bottom of the torso): solid transparent material, solid pale rose-pink cast glass, with soft internal swirls and tiny bubbles, deepest rose where thickest and nearly clear at every thin edge, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Left thigh (hip down to its tip, a short way down her thighs, just below the hip line): a sculpted vessel of the same clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles), completely filled to the brim with clear water holding a scattered handful of pale pink cherry-blossom petals drifting slowly inside it, never crowding, mostly open clear water around each one. It curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip, the water continuing unbroken down to that tip. Light passes through; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Right thigh (hip down to its tip, a short way down her thighs, just below the hip line): carved from ONE solid block of deep cobalt-blue cast glass, with slow internal swirls and tiny bubbles, near-navy where thickest and bright cobalt at every thin edge, never hollow, never split; suspended deep within it, visible through it like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are a dozen small, perfectly carved crystal butterflies with delicate translucent wings, each one a paler, brighter facet than the crystal around it, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity and no liquid around it. Light passes through the solid material; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it. The right thigh ends in its own smooth, deeply polished rounded tip, finished the way a carved sculpture is finished.

Where each material meets its neighbour (left shoulder, right shoulder, left hip, right hip, and every seam inside the torso), the two distinct materials sit flush against each other with a thin, clean seam, deliberate and precise, never jagged, torn or blended — always the finish of a sculpture, each material keeping its own colour, clarity and surface completely separate from the one beside it. Both thighs stay clearly separate all the way down, never merging into a single base, both rounded tips resting side by side on the surface beneath her.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a pale lilac on one side and a soft mint on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines so the bending of those lines is visible wherever the body is transparent, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so a pale lilac light glances off the left half and a soft mint light glances off the right half — passing straight through the transparent parts (left arm, left thigh, right thigh, torso piece 1, torso piece 3), while only reflecting off the opaque parts (right arm, torso piece 2). A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
